home.heroTitle: Where Gujarat's brands meet its best creators
home.heroText: Bluenova Creator Hub is a platform for collaborations between brands and creators. We verify creators, match them to brands and manage every collaboration from brief to payment. 🤝
home.howTitle: Simple for creators. Effortless for brands.
home.categoriesText: Send your best reels for your category. 😊
home.whyTitle: Why brands and creators choose Bluenova
home.why1t: Every creator profile and reel is reviewed by our team before approval.
home.why2t: Bluenova handles the brief, the shortlist, the offers and the follow-up for every collaboration.
home.why3t: We review drafts and make sure every paid post is labelled correctly.
home.why4t: Gujarati creators across Gujarat's cities, who know your audience.
home.pay1t: By bank transfer (NEFT/IMPS/RTGS) or UPI to Bluenova's official account.
home.pay2t: Our finance team matches the transaction reference with our bank statement.
home.pay3t: Work starts only after the payment is verified. Content is reviewed before it goes live.
home.pay4t: Bluenova pays creators directly after their post is verified.

faq.q: Is it free for creators to join?
faq.a: Yes. Creators never pay Bluenova. You receive a payout for every collaboration you complete.

faq.q: How long does the creator review take?
faq.a: Usually 3–5 working days. You can follow your status on your dashboard, and we notify you when there's a decision.

faq.q: Can brands or creators contact each other directly?
faq.a: No. Phone numbers and emails stay private. Every collaboration is managed by Bluenova, which protects both sides.
Creators from all over Gujarat — Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot and more — plus Mumbai and the rest of India.

home.ctaText: Create your free account in a minute.

faqPayment.a: Brands pay Bluenova by bank transfer or UPI and share the transaction reference. Our finance team verifies every payment before work starts. Creators are paid by Bluenova after their post is verified.
